description_en: Updates the information of a project that has been maintained in a specified enterprise
description_zh: 通过调用本接口，可以更新已经维护在指定企业内的项目信息
kebab_example: aliyun btripopen project-modify --third-part-id 300009 --project-name '商旅出差项目' --code pro_code_1234 --third-part-invoice-id invo_1234 --third-part-cost-center-id cost_1234 --x-acs-btrip-so-corp-token fet0000wls --has-manager false --api-version 2022-05-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ProjectModify

parameters.help_en: The ID of the project to update
parameters.name: third_part_id

parameters.help_en: The new invoice header ID bound to this project
parameters.help_zh: 更新后与本项目绑定的发票抬头 ID
parameters.name: third_part_invoice_id

parameters.help_en: The new cost center ID bound to this project
parameters.help_zh: 更新后于本项目绑定的成本呢中心 ID
parameters.name: third_part_cost_center_id

parameters.help_en:
The enterprise access token.

This is a required header parameter for HTTP calls. For information about how to obtain it, refer to Enterprise access token (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985).
You can use `corp_token=value` in the request URL as an alternative
parameters.help_zh:
企业访问凭证。

是 HTTP 调用方式的 header 必填参数之一，获取方式请参见：企业访问凭证 (https://openapi.alibtrip.com/doc/toDocDetail?docId=3769985)。
可以在请求地址中使用 `corp_token=value` 替代
parameters.name: x_acs_btrip_so_corp_token

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to set a project manager
parameters.name: has_manager
